_note: Top-level config keys per block, harvested from configs Attio's own UI wrote. Counts and value types only: no workspace slugs and no workflow titles. Modern engine only; legacy blocks arrive via the snapshot path in a different shape.
_app_note: Entries with provider "app" come from installed integrations and only apply to a workspace that has that app installed. Their config keys are portable; their provider ids are NOT. app_id and app_user_connection_membership_id are deliberately not recorded here - read them from the target workspace's own installation.
